purpose.reader_question: At which tested query counts does preprocessing repay its cost for repeated cohort-horizon queries?
purpose.expected_reading: Compare the total elapsed time of repeated scans with an indexed implementation whose total includes construction, queries and disposal; retain the one-query disadvantage.
purpose.claim: All 15 observed pairs favoured scanning at q=1 and indexing at q=100, the first sampled count with a unanimous indexed advantage; exact break-even is unmeasured.
purpose.scope: A Rust implementation on generated arrays of 100,000 accepted-output weighted events and 400,000 labour increments, three generator seeds, five fresh-process paired repetitions per seed, and q=1,10,100,1000 in the recorded execution environment. No full task roster or task-to-increment associations are represented.
permitted_inferences: Comparison of observed total machine elapsed times at the four measured query counts.
The one-query case can lose even when repeated querying benefits from indexing.
prohibited_inferences: An exact break-even query count between measured settings.
A confidence interval or a population performance guarantee from observed ranges.
A measured reduction in human labour, a causal AI-policy effect, or universal software speedup.
The generated arrays constitute a validated real-world observatory dataset.

inputs.source_reference: Retained machine elapsed timings from paired benchmark repetitions on generated records; generation is separate from timing evidence.
prepare.py validates complete matched records and calculates medians, minima, maxima and paired ratios without exclusions.
The proposed caption supplies the workload, run denominator, range meaning and scope restrictions.

quantities.label: Queries over the same cohort
quantities.definition: Number of horizon queries processed within a timed method call.
quantities.transformation: Four measured counts: 1,10,100,1000; log10 position, without interpolation claims.

missingness.treatment: All four registered settings must be present; other counts are unmeasured.

uncertainty.definition: Query count is set by the benchmark.

quantities.label: Repeated scan elapsed time
quantities.definition: Elapsed time to evaluate all q queries by repeated scans.
quantities.transformation: Nanoseconds divided by 1e6; median over the 15 retained seed/repetition observations at each q.

sample.inclusion: Every retained run: three generator seeds, five repetitions each; no exclusions.

missingness.treatment: Validation fails on missing or duplicate seed/repetition/query-count records; no imputation.

uncertainty.definition: Whiskers show the observed minimum and maximum across the 15 repetitions, not a confidence interval.
uncertainty.method: Exact min/max of retained times, with no nominal coverage.

quantities.label: Indexed total elapsed time
quantities.definition: Elapsed time from index construction through q indexed queries and disposal, including timestamp overhead.
quantities.transformation: Nanoseconds divided by 1e6; median over the 15 retained seed/repetition observations at each q; total time is independently timed rather than the sum of component medians.

sample.inclusion: The same 15 pairs as the scan method; one warm-up for each method precedes measurement.

missingness.treatment: Every timing must be positive and total must include measured build, query and drop components; no imputation.

uncertainty.definition: Whiskers show the observed minimum and maximum across the 15 repetitions, not a confidence interval.
uncertainty.method: Exact min/max of retained times, with no nominal coverage.

scale_or_mapping.definition: Horizontal log10 position at the four timed counts; line segments are visual guides only.

encodings.represents: Total elapsed time and retained variation

scale_or_mapping.definition: Vertical log10 milliseconds, using the same positive domain for both methods.
Dark dashed squares identify repeated scans; teal solid diamonds identify indexing. Direct endpoint labels preserve category identity in greyscale.

expected_labels: Observed machine timings on generated records
